title: Gender Bias in Contextualized Word Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: Intrinsic evaluation by measuring male/female pronoun and occupation co-occurrence frequencies in training data, analyzing the embedding geometry using PCA to identify a gender subspace, training an SVM classifier to predict entity gender from occupation embeddings, and extrinsic evaluation by measuring performance disparities on pro-stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical subsets of the WinoBias coreference resolution dataset.
